cpsFeature.note: The chrome-platform-showcase suite at conformanceRoute governs only the assertions it explicitly lists; it does not prove unasserted native, hardware, permission, backend, or other behavior. gendn references that listed contract without forking it.

assertions.describe: The stable route /v151/languagedetector-support-for-traditional-vs-simplified-chinese/ responds 200 (durable-demo contract).
Page carries its canonical chromestatus.com/feature/5138651886518272 link — the immutable feature identity (CLAUDE.md invariant #3) and the milestone-151 mapping's self-heal.
Document has a non-empty <title> for the reference page.
Exactly one <h1> — the API name (listing name), MDN-shaped article heading.
A single <main> landmark wraps the article content.
Shared editorial design system /public/styles.css is linked.
Responsive viewport meta present (width=device-width) for mobile+desktop parity.
Breadcrumb links back to the /v151/ release index.
Byline footer present (article provenance).
Every target=_blank link carries rel=noopener (no reverse-tabnabbing; MDN-style external link hygiene).
No anchor has an empty or placeholder (#) href.
assertions.test: [...document.querySelectorAll('a')].every(el => { const h = el.getAttribute('href'); return h && h !== '#'; })

assertions.describe: Page loads with no console errors.
No failed (>=400 / net-error) network requests on load.
No unintended horizontal overflow at desktop (1280x800).
No unintended horizontal overflow at narrow mobile (360x740, DPR3).
Desktop render is legible, contrast passes WCAG AA, controls/text not clipped (screenshot review).
Mobile render is legible with adequate tap targets and no clipped text/controls (screenshot review).
The <h1> is the chromestatus milestone-listing name for this feature (not the broader detail name) — factual/source fidelity.
Frontend implementation consulted modern-web-guidance for its UI/responsive/a11y topics and applied or justified them (recorded in _questions.json guidanceConsulted).
Stub shows the 'documented on MDN' card explaining gendn doesn't duplicate MDN.
Stub links out to the canonical developer.mozilla.org page for the feature.

The linked MDN page genuinely covers the LanguageDetector API (substantive interface/property/method inventory, create() and detect() examples showing detectedLanguage + confidence, Specifications, and Browser compatibility sections, verified 2026-07-26) — accurate 'covered on MDN' claim (source review).

Executable doc-quality check: the feature contract is documented with the exact boundary — output may now be zh-Hans/zh-Hant from input text; script-unique UnicodeSet counting with majority wins; tie/all-common default zh-Hans; undefined for non-Chinese input; no requested-locale/region mapping; Translate-path legacy zh-CN/zh-TW cited as NOT this API's output.
assertions.test: (() => { const t = document.body.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' '); if (!/unique to each script/i.test(t)) return false; if (!/majority wins/i.test(t)) return false; if (!/undefined for non-Chinese input/i.test(t)) return false; if (!/zh-CN/.test(t) || !/zh-TW/.test(t)) return false; if (!/not the LanguageDetector output/i.test(t)) return false; if (/best-fit/i.test(t)) return false; return true; })()

assertions.describe: Executable doc-quality check: the pinned WPT detector.optional test (Simplified → zh-Hans, Traditional → zh-Hant) is linked, and the strict-'zh' migration (may never be true; startsWith arc match) is stated.
assertions.test: (() => { const html = document.body.innerHTML; if (!html.includes('ai/language_detection/detector.optional.https.window.js')) return false; const t = document.body.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' '); if (!/may never be true/i.test(t)) return false; return t.includes('startsWith("zh-")'); })()

assertions.describe: The target runtime behavior (detection of Simplified text returning zh-Hans and Traditional text returning zh-Hant, bare zh absent) is NOT asserted locally — Chrome 150 predates the feature and model availability is download-dependent; verification requires a Chrome 151+ engine per the pinned WPT detector.optional contract.
